name: The Sundering Scar
description: the Sundering Scar at first light: a vast circular crater of fused black glass cracked open like a shattered mirror, a ten-pointed sigil burned into the ground and glowing violet along its seams, broken obsidian obelisks leaning around the rim, nine long streaks of coloured light arcing away across a pale violet-grey dawn sky, ravens and bats wheeling above, pale wisps of spirits drifting up from the cracks
